summary: Tested HR Admin Review Tab feature. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all requested features: Reviews tab in navigation, three review type tabs (Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly), period filter changes based on tab, employee list loads, review popup shows attendance/working hours/delivery timeline cards, HR|Operations|CEO reviewer tabs, 5-star rating, review submission, and edit/delete buttons on submitted reviews.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test review during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: HR Admin Review Tab fully tested. Navigate to HR Admin > Click Reviews tab to see the feature. Features verified: 1) Reviews tab appears in HR Admin navigation 2) Three review type tabs: Monthly Review, Quarterly Review, Yearly Review 3) Period filter changes based on tab (month picker for monthly, quarter dropdown for quarterly, year dropdown for yearly) 4) Employee list loads with 8 employees 5) Clicking employee opens review popup modal 6) Popup shows employee name, designation, period 7) Popup shows Attendance card (Present, Absent, Leave days) 8) Popup shows Working Hours card (Total, Extra, Average Daily) 9) Popup shows Delivery Timeline card (Total Tasks, On Time, Overdue) 10) On Time/Overdue values are clickable (underlined) 11) HR|Operations|CEO reviewer tabs work 12) 5-star rating can be selected 13) Review text can be entered 14) Submit Review creates new review with toast notification 15) Submitted reviews show with edit/delete buttons 16) Backend endpoints tested: GET /api/hr/employee-reviews/employees, GET /api/hr/employee-reviews/employee/{id}/summary, GET /api/hr/employee-reviews/employee/{id}/tasks, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/hr/performance-reviews
